full_inspection: Compared all four native halves line by line, including the displayed rho formula, inequality, three underlines, original wide spaces and marginal traces. The typed matter agrees; the archive foliations differ.
original_transcription_comparison: Compared both complete original transcriptions. They share the unsupported hand label on the inequality, corrected after direct image comparison; archives20/96 are distinct.

entries.decision: classify the copy2 inequality as typed
entries.reason: The same straight fixed contour and terminals occur in both impressions and in the earlier typed inequality; increased ink weight alone supplies no hand evidence.

entries.decision: retain both archive foliations without author attribution
entries.reason: Both lower-left handwritten numerals are clear.
